description_en: Requests a new free certificate for a Software as a Service (SaaS) domain name. Call this operation only if the previous certificate request failed, or the current certificate is about to expire or has expired
description_zh: 重新申请 SaaS 域名的免费证书，仅支持当前免费证书申请失败、即将过期、已过期时调用
name: ApplyCustomHostnameCertificate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SaaS domain name. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: SaaS 域名的 ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html接口获取
parameters.name: hostname_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates this ID for each request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
